spin bike all in one machine. It has a 19" touch screen console (you can swipe like you do an 
Iphone) You can get internet and TV (BUT, this must be hard wired, no wifi) You can incline. It 
lists for $11,995.00

exchange the Precor you have now for the AMT they will work with you re the restocking fee.

need to make sure this machine can go up in the elevator and make any turns that are required. It 
is a 3 person job for delivery. Weighs 422 lbs. Leisure Fitness has one in stock. 
Just FYI-Leisure Fitness does not carry Cybex. The Cybex "arc trainer" only has one motion 
where the AMT 885 has 4 motions. 
Please advise what you would like to do.
